item.title: Ezee Fiber acquires DayNet fiber assets
item.description: Ezee Fiber has acquired the assets and network of DayNet, a residential fiber network built by the city of Dayton, Texas, in 2022. #pressrelease.

item.title: NTCA appoints Mike Romano as new CEO
item.description: Mike Romano will assume the role of CEO at NTCA–The Rural Broadband Association, effective March 15, following the retirement of current CEO Shirley Bloomfield. #pressrelease

item.title: PowerX debuts AI-backed maintenance program for tower operations
item.description: PowerX has launched AI Maintenance, an AI-powered platform for tower owners that covers areas such as workflow, scheduling and mobile workforce management. #pressrelease

item.title: 5G network slicing not ready for prime time in UK
item.description: UK mobile operators have accelerated 5G standalone rollouts, but not one is ready yet to launch commercial network slicing services.

item.title: Mainland China's cloud infrastructure market accelerates to 24% growth in Q3 2025 – Omdia
item.description: This marked the second consecutive quarter of growth above 20%. #pressrelease

item.title: Data center physical infrastructure market to surpass $80B by 2030 – Dell'Oro
item.description: Power constraints and technology disruption continue to reshape data center architectures. #pressrelease

item.title: Kinsey Fabrizio to succeed Gary Shapiro as CTA's CEO
item.description: Kinsey Fabrizio will become president and CEO of the Consumer Technology Association effective May 1, succeeding Gary Shapiro, who will serve as organization's executive chair. #pressrelease

item.title: Newsmax CEO threatens to sue if FCC raises broadcast ownership cap
item.description: If the FCC raises the ownership cap to accommodate the Nexstar-Tegna deal, Newsmax is 'prepared to litigate the matter,' says CEO Chris Ruddy. Meanwhile, NAB argues that more industry consolidation is needed as it battles with big tech for programming, sports rights and ad dollars.

item.title: NTCA ups Mike Romano to CEO
item.description: Mike Romano, NTCA's executive VP, has been appointed CEO of the rural-focused organization, effective March 15. He succeeds the retiring Shirley Bloomfield. #pressrelease

item.title: Mediacom wraps network upgrades in Cedar Rapids
item.description: Mediacom has completed multi-gigabit and symmetrical speed upgrades in Cedar Rapids, Iowa. #pressrelease
